summary: IDF eliminated over 10 Hamas operatives in Gaza including October 7 Nukhba commander and destroyed weapons production facility in systematic ceasefire violation response. Simultaneous West Bank operations arrested over 55 suspects including Islamic State-affiliated cell in Jenin planning attacks on civilians. Lebanon border endured 125 alerts with 61 drone sightings and artillery shelling across four sectors while Iran experienced barracks explosions, missile launches, and heightened UAV activity near Iraqi borders.
key_points: IDF eliminated over 10 Gaza terror operatives including October 7 Nukhba commander and destroyed Hamas weapons production site. (Source: @manniefabian/59516)
Israeli forces arrested four wanted Palestinians in Jenin, two linked to Islamic State, planning attacks on civilians. (Source: @manniefabian/59515)
West Bank sweep detained over 55 Hamas and PIJ suspects, seized weapons, demolished incitement monuments in Etzion. (Source: @yediotnews25/137787)
Airstrikes hit Gaza City's Zeitoun neighborhood causing two casualties per Palestinian media reports. (Source: @yediotnews25/137792)
Lebanon border endured artillery shelling at Doha KfarRoumane, Zoutar Al-Sharqiya, Wadi Al-Hajir, Wadi Al-Saluqi with 125 alerts and 61 drone sightings. (Source: @redlinkleb/53094)
Third explosion struck Iran's 15 Khordad barracks warehouse in Isfahan; missile launches reported in western Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/12329)
UAV activity detected over Piranshahr and Iraqi borders in West Azerbaijan; jet activity over Saqqez, Kurdistan. (Source: @shin_persian/12337)
USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier group estimated entering Arabian Sea; US 5th Fleet commander coordinated with Israeli Navy in Bahrain. (Source: @shin_persian/12338)

points: Third explosion hit 15 Khordad military barracks warehouse in Isfahan at 1324Z, following earlier blasts; source notes "exactly in the barracks' warehouse area." (Source: @shin_persian/12329)
Secondhand reports indicate large number of missiles launched in western Iran around 1400Z (17:30 Tehran time); details on missile types or targets unspecified. (Source: @shin_persian/12333)
Missile launcher observed on Baharestan-to-Mohammadabad road in Isfahan Province, suggesting mobile deployment preparation. (Source: @shin_persian/12342)
Intense UAV activity recorded over Piranshahr near Iraqi border in West Azerbaijan at 1718Z, and over Iraqi borders at 1541Z. (Source: @shin_persian/12337)
Jet activity detected over Saqqez in Kurdistan Province at 1436Z; separate jet departed Doran Air Base at 1730Z heading south. (Source: @shin_persian/12332)

IDF confirmed killing over 10 terror operatives in Gaza past week, including Muhammad Atta Zaki Qishawi (Hamas Nukhba Force, Oct 7 infiltrator), Ali Naim Ayesh Abu Osai (Saif al-Islam weapons manufacturer), and Hani Ibrahim Said Khudari (Sabra Battalion supply commander, Oct 7 participant). (Source: @manniefabian/59516)

Hamas weapons production headquarters workshop destroyed in strike; IDF states operatives were advancing attacks and restoring capabilities in "systematic violation of the ceasefire." (Source: @manniefabian/59516)

Paratroopers Brigade with Shin Bet intelligence arrested four wanted Palestinians in Jenin area; two affiliated with Islamic State, all planned attacks on Israeli civilians and forces. (Source: @manniefabian/59515)

US 5th Fleet Commander Vice Adm. Curt Renshaw visited Israel, met Israeli Navy Chief Vice Adm. Eyal Harel; discussed operational coordination, maritime security, technological sharing amid low-level fighting against Iran in Gulf. (Source: @manniefabian/59514)
Mossad chief reportedly in Washington as Netanyahu pressures Trump to resume war; political-diplomatic track running parallel to military operations. (Source: @yediotnews25/137798)
Palestinian media report Israeli airstrikes on Zeitoun neighborhood in Gaza City resulting in two wounded; strikes described as continuing remote targeting. (Source: @yediotnews25/137792)
IDF weekly tally: over 10 terror operatives killed in Gaza, weapons production site destroyed, operatives linked to October 7 and ceasefire violations. (Source: @manniefabian/59516)
West Bank operation arrested over 55 wanted persons across Judea and Samaria including Hamas and PIJ activists planning attacks; large weapons cache seized. (Source: @yediotnews25/137787)
Etzion Brigade demolished incitement monuments honoring terror organization founders and additional militants; part of broader counter-incitement effort. (Source: @yediotnews25/137787)
Jenin raid by Paratroopers Brigade netted four suspects with Islamic State ties; intelligence-driven operation based on Shin Bet information. (Source: @manniefabian/59515)
Artillery shelling reported at Doha KfarRoumane, Zoutar Al-Sharqiya (two incidents), Wadi Al-Hajir (three incidents), and Wadi Al-Saluqi across the border area. (Source: @redlinkleb/53105)

End-of-day report for November 13, 2026 records 125 total alerts, 61 drone sightings; top drone-monitored villages: Kfar Djal (4), Jibchit (4), Abba (3), Qabrikha (3), Selaa/Tyre (3). (Source: @redlinkleb/53094)
Most active districts: Nabatieh (59 alerts), Marjayoun (34), Tyre (25); air strikes recorded: 3 on Khiam, 2 on Kfar Tibn. (Source: @redlinkleb/53094)
Alert issued for drone detected on coastal line heading toward Beirut; live map tracking active. (Source: @redlinkleb/53120)
Fire sweeping operations reported at Zoutar Al-Sharqiya and Wadi Al-Hajir indicating ground force activity or clearance operations. (Source: @redlinkleb/53093)
Intense UAV activity observed over Iraqi borders in Iran's West Azerbaijan Province at 1541Z, suggesting cross-border surveillance or operations. (Source: @shin_persian/12336)
UAV activity over Piranshahr in West Azerbaijan at 1718Z, near the Iraq-Iran border region, indicating persistent aerial monitoring. (Source: @shin_persian/12337)
No direct reports from Syrian territory in current dataset; Iranian western missile launches at 1400Z may relate to Iraq-Syria corridor but unconfirmed. (Source: @shin_persian/12333)

US 5th Fleet headquartered in Bahrain conducted commander-level visit to Israel; Vice Adm. Curt Renshaw discussed partnership, maritime route security, and coordination with Israeli Navy. (Source: @manniefabian/59514)
5th Fleet engaged in low-level fighting against Iran in Gulf and Strait of Hormuz in recent months amid American naval blockade of Iranian ports. (Source: @manniefabian/59514)

USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) carrier strike group tracked transiting toward Arabian Sea; estimated west of Mumbai by mid-November if maintaining 18.5 knots from Nov 8 position. (Source: @shin_persian/12338)
